text: E5 is the first model to outperform the strong BM25 baseline on the BEIR zero-shot retrieval benchmark without using any labeled data [S1][S2]. On the MIRACL dataset, M3-Embedding's sparse retrieval functionality outperforms BM25 [S5]. However, M3-Embedding (Sparse) performs badly compared with other methods because there are only very limited co-existed terms for cross-lingual retrieval [S6].
